Home.faq1Answer: Yes. Every mode, every language and every lifeline is free to play, with no sign-up needed for Classic.
Home.faq2Question: Where do the questions come from?
Home.faq2Answer: An AI question writer creates them natively in your language, and every question is checked automatically before it reaches the game. If something slips through, you can report it in one tap.
Home.faq3Question: How do the safe havens work?
Home.faq3Answer: Answering question 5 correctly guarantees {havenOne}, and question 10 guarantees {havenTwo}. If you answer a later question wrong, you still leave with the last safe haven you passed.
Home.faq4Answer: Yes — Classic works offline. Questions in your language are saved on your device automatically, and offline games sync when you reconnect. Marathon and Time Attack need a connection.
Home.faq5Question: How do I get on the leaderboard?
Home.faq5Answer: Sign in and play a ranked Marathon or Time Attack run. Every answer is checked by our server, so the leaderboard stays fair.
Home.faq6Question: Is this the official TV show game?
Home.faq6Answer: No. Millionaire is an independent, fan-made game inspired by the classic quiz show format.
Home.faqLanguageQuestion: Can I play Millionaire in English?
Home.faqLanguageAnswer: Yes — this is the English version of the game. Every question is written in English for English speakers rather than translated, and every mode and lifeline is free. The game is also available in 79 other languages.

Rules.title: How to play
Rules.intro: Everything you need to know about the three game modes, the money ladder and the lifelines.
Rules.classicBody1: You face fifteen multiple-choice questions, each with four possible answers. The questions start easy and get harder as the money grows, from {first} for question 1 up to {top} for question 15.
Rules.classicBody2: Pick an answer, then confirm it as your final answer. If you're right, you climb one rung of the money ladder. If you're wrong, the game ends.
Rules.safeHavensBody: Questions 5 and 10 are safe havens. Once you answer them correctly, {havenOne} and then {havenTwo} are guaranteed — a later wrong answer drops you back to the last safe haven, not to zero.
Rules.walkAwayBody: Before you lock in an answer you can walk away and keep everything you have banked so far. Sometimes the smartest move is to stop.
Rules.timerBody: By default there's no time limit. In the game settings you can allow 30 seconds, 1 minute or 3 minutes per question.
Rules.lifelinesBody: You have four lifelines, and each can be used once per game:
Rules.marathonBody: An endless run. The questions get harder every five correct answers, you have the four lifelines once each, and you get {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} for each question. One wrong answer or a timeout ends the run, and your score is the number of correct answers.
Rules.timeAttackBody: You have {seconds} seconds to answer as many questions as you can. A wrong answer doesn't end the run, but it takes {penalty} seconds off the clock. There are no lifelines.
Rules.rankedBody: Marathon and Time Attack runs are always refereed by our server: the correct answer never reaches your device before you answer, and the clock is kept on the server. They need an account, so every run counts on the leaderboard; Classic plays without one.
Rules.questionsBody: Questions are written by an AI question writer natively in each language and checked automatically. Around 40% are about the culture where your language is spoken. If a question looks wrong, use “Report a mistake” after the answer is revealed.

About.title: About Millionaire
About.intro: Millionaire is a free, fan-made quiz game inspired by the classic television format — rebuilt for the web, for phones, and for 80 languages.
About.missionBody: Most quiz games are written in English and translated. We think a quiz should feel like home: the questions should be about the people, places, books and traditions you grew up with, as well as the wider world.
About.howBody: A large language model writes every question natively in your language, in batches, following strict rules: one clearly correct answer, four plausible options, stable facts only. Questions are validated automatically, stored, and served to players; any player can report a mistake.
About.techBody: Millionaire is a progressive web app: it installs on your phone or computer, works offline with questions saved automatically, and syncs your progress when you reconnect.
About.disclaimer: Millionaire is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to any television programme, broadcaster or rights holder.

Legal.privacyIntro: We collect as little as we can. This page explains what we store and why.
Legal.privacyDataBody: If you play without signing in, your settings, scores and badges stay on your device. If you have an account, we store your email address, your display name, your profile picture and your game results, so that your progress follows you and the leaderboard can show your name. Signing in with Google adds your Google account id; signing in with a password adds only a one-way hash of it — never the password itself. We use your email address only for messages about your account, such as confirming it or resetting your password.
Legal.privacyUseBody: Your data is used only to run the game: to show your profile and leaderboard entries and to keep your progress. We never sell it or share it with advertisers.
Legal.privacyAnalyticsBody: We may use privacy-friendly analytics and error reports to understand which features are used and to fix bugs. These never include the content of your answers.
Legal.privacyAdsBody: Some pages show ads from Google AdSense, never during a game. Google and its partners use cookies to show you ads based on your earlier visits to this and other websites. You can turn off personalized ads in <settings>Google's ad settings</settings> and read <partners>how Google uses information from sites that use its services</partners>. In the EEA, the UK and Switzerland you are asked for your consent first.
Legal.privacyRightsBody: You can change your display name and picture at any time, and you can ask us to delete your account and all associated data by contacting the author.
Legal.termsIntro: By playing Millionaire you agree to these simple terms.
Legal.termsPlayBody: Play ranked runs honestly. Automated play, exploiting bugs or interfering with the leaderboard may lead to your runs being removed.
Legal.termsContentBody: Questions are generated automatically and may occasionally contain mistakes. They are provided for entertainment only. Prize amounts are virtual — no real money is involved.
Legal.termsNamesBody: Don't use names or pictures that are offensive, impersonate others or infringe anyone's rights. We may change or remove them.
